entry: Deployed async job pattern to OSINT server. POST /api/investigate/v2 was holding HTTP connections open for 8 minutes — browsers timed out, timers froze at 0:00. Refactored to immediate jobId return + polling. Also fixed in-memory report list bug. What drove me: users hitting a broken UI repeatedly wondering what's wrong. The fix was mechanical but the reason was human frustration. Worth fixing right.
